note: Integration candidates. Each groups the manual system-to-system exchanges of its items. ease: 3 easy, 2 medium, 1 hard. volume: records moved per issue, 1 tens, 2 hundreds, 3 thousands. Both are assumptions to confirm with IT, the tool owners and the discipline leads.

candidates.name: Simulation to process data
candidates.path: HYSYS → datasheets, line list, SI, HTRI
candidates.flow: Stream, case and duty data copied from HYSYS into datasheets, the line list, SI process data and HTRI inputs.
candidates.ease_note: HYSYS exposes stream data through its spreadsheet and automation interface; the targets take tabular imports.
candidates.approach: Publish a tagged stream table from each HYSYS case revision and load it into datasheet templates and SI process data, keyed by stream and line number.

candidates.name: Line list as one record
candidates.path: SPID line data ↔ line sizing ↔ S3D, SI, CAESAR II
candidates.flow: Line sizes, process conditions, design pressure and temperature and piping class copied between SPID, the line-sizing workbook, S3D, SI and stress.
candidates.ease_note: Line data sits in SPID and in workbooks at once; one home has to be chosen before anything can be linked.
candidates.approach: Make one line list the record (SPID line properties or the registry), with Process and Piping each owning their columns; S3D, SI and CAESAR II read from it.
candidates.prerequisite: Agreed line numbering and line-list ownership by column

candidates.name: P&ID tags into the instrument index
candidates.path: SPID → SI
candidates.flow: Instrument tags, loops and control valve data re-typed from issued P&IDs into SI, SI sizes back onto the P&IDs, and SI data re-typed into requisition and vendor documents.
candidates.ease_note: Both are Octave tools, but the SPF publish/retrieve link works poorly today; a direct tag compare works without SPF.
candidates.approach: Compare SPID and SI tag lists on every P&ID issue; report new, deleted and changed tags for I&C to accept, instead of re-reading drawings.

candidates.name: In-line instrument and routing data to the model
candidates.path: SI ↔ S3D
candidates.flow: In-line instrument dimensions, flow-element straight runs, junction boxes and tray routing passed between SI and S3D by hand.
candidates.ease_note: S3D and SI share tag numbers but no live link; dimensional tables export from SI cleanly.
candidates.approach: Export SI dimensional data by tag for S3D placement; return routed lengths and junction box locations to SI.

candidates.name: Piping specs to the model, SI and purchasing
candidates.path: Piping class spec → S3D, SI, Purchasing DB
candidates.flow: Piping class ratings, materials and commodity codes re-entered into the S3D catalogue, SI and purchasing.
candidates.ease_note: The S3D spec is already structured; the work is mapping commodity codes to purchasing idents once.
candidates.approach: Treat the S3D spec as the record and publish class and commodity tables to SI and the purchasing database.
candidates.prerequisite: Commodity code to purchasing ident map

candidates.name: Equipment register
candidates.path: Process and mechanical datasheets → S3D, SI, SPEL, HTRI, calc tools
candidates.flow: Equipment tags, duties, sizes, nozzles and outline data copied from Excel datasheets and lists into the model, SI, SPEL and design tools.
candidates.ease_note: Equipment data lives in Excel datasheets; it needs a structured equipment register before it can be shared.
candidates.approach: Hold equipment attributes in one register keyed by tag (CFIHOS equipment classes); datasheets, S3D, SI and SPEL read from it.

candidates.name: Electrical loads and studies
candidates.path: Motor and package data → SPEL ↔ ETAP
candidates.flow: Motor ratings, load lists, certified electrical data and study results moved between Mechanical, vendors, SPEL and ETAP.
candidates.ease_note: ETAP has an established data exchange with SPEL; the load list is already structured in SPEL.
candidates.approach: Use SPEL as the load record and run the SPEL–ETAP exchange for loads, ratings and study results; collect other disciplines' loads on one template.
candidates.prerequisite: Load list template for other disciplines

candidates.name: I&C–electrical signals
candidates.path: SPEL ↔ SI
candidates.flow: MCC and switchgear signals, interlock schematics, heat tracing alarms and area classification passed between SPEL and SI.
candidates.ease_note: Same vendor, same tag conventions; the signal list is structured on both sides.
candidates.approach: Exchange the MCC/switchgear interface signal list by tag between SPEL and SI on each issue.

candidates.name: Relief and flare data
candidates.path: Relief tool ↔ SI, CAESAR II, equipment data
candidates.flow: Relief loads, PSV datasheets, flare back-pressures and final valve sizing re-entered between the relief tool, SI, stress and datasheets.
candidates.ease_note: The relief tool output is tabular; PSV tags already exist in SI.
candidates.approach: Publish the relief load summary by PSV tag into SI; return the agreed vendor sizing to the relief and flare model.

candidates.name: Safety lifecycle to design
candidates.path: PHA tool → SPID, SI, DCS/SIS
candidates.flow: HAZOP actions, SIL targets, SIFs, trips and cause-and-effects carried by hand from the PHA tool and Word into SPID, SI and the DCS/SIS.
candidates.ease_note: PHA records are structured; the cause-and-effect and SRS are Word or Excel documents.
candidates.approach: Keep the SIF and trip list as data keyed by instrument tag, linked to HAZOP/LOPA scenario IDs; generate cause-and-effects from it.

candidates.name: Requisitions into purchasing
candidates.path: Document Locator / Excel → Purchasing DB
candidates.flow: Requisition headers and lines, bidders, bid bulletins, awards and POs typed from documents into the purchasing database.
candidates.ease_note: The purchasing database is in-house SQL, so you control its import.
candidates.approach: Issue each requisition with a structured header and line file alongside the PDF; the purchasing database imports it and returns the MR number.

candidates.name: Material take-off into purchasing
candidates.path: S3D / Excel MTOs → Purchasing DB
candidates.flow: Piping, instrument, steel and spares quantities re-typed from MTO workbooks into purchasing.
candidates.ease_note: S3D produces MTO reports by ident; the database is yours.
candidates.approach: Load MTOs by ident and revision into the purchasing database and compute the delta to buy, applying the surplus policy.
candidates.prerequisite: Commodity code to purchasing ident map

candidates.name: Receipt to site
candidates.path: Purchasing DB / vendors → Jovix → Procore, iConstruct
candidates.flow: Shipping notices, packing lists, MTRs, receipts, issues and shortages keyed between purchasing, vendors, Jovix and the field tools.
candidates.ease_note: Jovix takes PO and shipment imports; field tools need only status by IWP.
candidates.approach: Load PO lines and shipping notices into Jovix from the purchasing database; publish availability and shortages to iConstruct by IWP.
candidates.prerequisite: PO line to Jovix item mapping

candidates.name: Procurement status to the schedule
candidates.path: Purchasing DB ↔ P6
candidates.flow: Need dates, PO dates, vendor print status and delivery forecasts copied between the purchasing database and P6.
candidates.ease_note: P6 has a documented API and the purchasing database is yours.
candidates.approach: Link each MR and PO to its P6 activity; push forecasts to P6 and pull need dates back nightly.

candidates.name: Deliverables, numbering and progress
candidates.path: Document Locator ↔ P6 ↔ discipline lists
candidates.flow: Deliverable lists, document numbers, WBS and cost codes, schedule dates and progress re-keyed between Document Locator, P6 and discipline workbooks.
candidates.ease_note: Both systems take structured imports; numbering is a rule, not a document.
candidates.approach: One deliverables register keyed by document number feeds Document Locator and P6; progress comes from document status, not workbooks.

candidates.name: Model to construction work packages
candidates.path: S3D, SPEL, SI → iConstruct, Procore
candidates.flow: IFC isometrics, supports, cable and instrument schedules, steel and CWP scope moved by hand into iConstruct and Procore.
candidates.ease_note: iConstruct reads S3D directly; SPEL, SI and Tekla content needs CWA/CWP codes assigned first.
candidates.approach: Assign CWA/CWP codes in each authoring tool and let iConstruct read model and schedule data by code; IFC release status comes from Document Locator.

candidates.name: Systemization and completions
candidates.path: SPID, SI, S3D → Smart Completions ↔ P6
candidates.flow: System boundaries, tag-to-system assignments, ITR requirements, test packs, punch and turnover status keyed into Smart Completions and back.
candidates.ease_note: Smart Completions imports tag registers; the system-to-tag link has to exist in the design tools first.
candidates.approach: Assign system and subsystem codes to tags in SPID; load the full tag register with those codes into Smart Completions from the tag crosswalk.
candidates.prerequisite: Tag crosswalk; system codes on tags

candidates.name: Structural interfaces
candidates.path: S3D ↔ Tekla, loads and civil data
candidates.flow: Rack and structure configuration, support loads, equipment loads and underground data passed between S3D, Tekla and civil calcs.
candidates.ease_note: S3D and Tekla exchange steel models; loads are still calc reports.
candidates.approach: Exchange steel between S3D and Tekla by model import; publish support and equipment loads as tables keyed by support and foundation mark.

candidates.name: Pipe stress interfaces
candidates.path: S3D ↔ CAESAR II ↔ equipment
candidates.flow: Nozzle allowables, thermal growth, stress markups and results passed by hand between equipment data, CAESAR II and the model.
candidates.ease_note: S3D-to-CAESAR II export exists; nozzle data comes from datasheets.
candidates.approach: Export stress lines from S3D to CAESAR II; carry nozzle allowables from the equipment register.

candidates.name: As-built and field changes
candidates.path: Procore → SPID, S3D, SI, SPEL, Tekla
candidates.flow: Redlines, RFIs, field changes and dispositions read from Procore and re-drawn in each design tool.
candidates.ease_note: The edits are drawing judgements; what can be linked is the tag and document reference, not the change itself.
candidates.approach: Tag each RFI, field change and redline with document number and tags so that each design tool sees open changes against its objects.

candidates.name: Design basis values
candidates.path: Basis documents → calcs and design tools
candidates.flow: Site conditions, design criteria, assays and philosophies read from basis documents and re-typed into every calculation.
candidates.ease_note: No tool link is needed: the values only have to be published once as data.
candidates.approach: Publish each basis as a governed parameter table (site data, criteria, cases) that calculations reference instead of copying.

candidates.name: Vendor data into engineering
candidates.path: Certified vendor documents → engineering tools
candidates.flow: Certified drawings, loads, nameplate data and IOMs read from vendor PDFs and re-typed into engineering tools and the asset register.
candidates.ease_note: It depends on vendors returning structured data, which only the purchase order can require.
candidates.approach: Require CFIHOS vendor data sheets (Excel by tag) in every PO and load them to the equipment register on receipt.
candidates.prerequisite: CFIHOS vendor data requirements in POs; Equipment class library
